endpoints // full toolkit

  
ek key — sab kuch. docs: github.com/VIP-saksham/api

  

    
GET/api/stream?url=YT_URL&type=audio— instant stream URL (cached ~3ms)

    
GET/search?q=song+name— library-first, innertube fallback

    
GET/info?url=YT_URL— title, duration, thumbnail, uploader

    
GET/file/{id}— zero-proxy audio/video file streaming

    
GET/ytdl?url=YT_URL&format=ID— raw yt-dlp style output
